Following the skill as-written would produce the wrong artifact path.

diagnoses.description: `convert_pdf_to_images.convert()` saves images into `output_dir` but never creates the directory. If `output_dir` does not already exist, `image.save(...)` will fail with a file-not-found error, breaking the documented workflow (`convert_pdf_to_images.py <file.pdf> <output_directory>`).

`check_fillable_fields.py` runs unguarded top-level code that immediately accesses `sys.argv[1]` without checking argument count and without an `if __name__ == "__main__"` guard. Importing the module (or running it with missing args) will raise `IndexError` rather than printing usage/help.
